response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale cloud infrastructure or distributed systems leadership; their work is predominantly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with minimal evidence of cloud compute platform ownership or mentoring in cloud/DevOps contexts, making them a poor fit for the core technical requirements.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across multiple languages and domains
Proven track record of open-source contributions and technical mentoring
Experience with distributed systems and CI/CD infrastructure
concerns: Only sporadic C++ exposure, far below the 8-year minimum requirement
No demonstrable experience with cloud compute platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure infrastructure)
Lacks explicit technical leadership in cloud or DevOps engineering teams
